The budget is denominated in lockfile packages and those spend it too, so this needs hv before it needs a gate." My design missed that gate. (C) check all: all passed. So 5924fbe5 is NOT landable as is. Proposed design change, for your read: drop the manifests' part entirely (no [dev-dependencies], no [features] in artifact), and compile artifact::testing always, as #[doc(hidden)] pub mod testing. The tests of prez and showreel reach it through the dependency they already have; no manifest moves, so tests/manifest.rs holds unchanged and needs no hv sign-off; the release binaries never call it, so LTO drops it, which (P)'s message check proves (cargo tree's part has nothing left to show). The other route is hv's sign-off on a first-party-only [dev-dependencies] table and a gate edit, which the gate says comes first; I recommend the first. On your word I rework the candidate (17 files instead of 20), re-run fmt, and START a heavy 0093 re-run: G, C and P again (M stands at 82), and dc's leg on the new bytes.
